actions.description: Add a task to a project, optionally into a section.
actions.name: add-project-to-task

task_gid.description: The task to operate on. Example: "1200000000000001"

project.description: The project to add the task to. Example: "1200000000000002"

section.description: The section to add the task to within the project. Example: "1200000000000003"

insert_after.description: A task ID to position this task after within the project or section. Example: "1200000000000004"

insert_before.description: A task ID to position this task before within the project or section. Example: "1200000000000005"

actions.description: Attach an existing tag to a task.
actions.name: add-tag-to-task

task_gid.description: The task to operate on. Example: "1200000000000001"

tag_gid.description: The tag to add to the task. Example: "1200000000000002"

actions.description: Create a project in a workspace or team.
actions.name: create-project

name.description: Name of the project. Example: "Q1 Marketing Plan"

workspace_gid.description: The workspace or organization GID to create the project in. Example: "1202775892569436"

team_gid.description: The team GID to share the project with. Required if the workspace is an organization. Example: "1214299875377454"

privacy_setting.description: The privacy setting of the project. Example: "public_to_workspace"

notes.description: Free-form textual information associated with the project (description).

due_date.description: The date at which the project is due. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

start_on.description: The day on which the project starts. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

default_view.description: The default view of the project. Example: "list"

owner.description: The user GID of the project owner. Example: "12345"

actions.description: Create a section in a project.
actions.name: create-section

project_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the project. Example: "12345"

name.description: The text to be displayed as the section name. This cannot be an empty string. Example: "Next Actions"

insert_before.description: An existing section within this project before which the added section should be inserted. Cannot be provided together with insert_after.

insert_after.description: An existing section within this project after which the added section should be inserted. Cannot be provided together with insert_before.

actions.description: Create a comment or story entry on a task.
actions.name: create-story-on-task

task_gid.description: The task to operate on. Example: "123456789"

text.description: The plain text of the comment to add. Cannot be used with html_text.

html_text.description: HTML formatted text for a comment. Cannot be used with text.

actions.description: Create a subtask under a parent task.
actions.name: create-subtask

parent_task_gid.description: The globally unique identifier of the parent task. Example: "12345"

name.description: The name of the subtask. Example: "Review draft"

assignee.description: The user gid to assign the subtask to. Example: "67890"

due_on.description: Localized due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-12-31"

due_at.description: UTC due date-time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-12-31T23:59:59.000Z"

projects.description: Array of project gids to associate with the subtask at creation time.

workspace.description: The workspace gid for the subtask. Example: "54321"

followers.description: Array of user gids to add as followers.

tags.description: Array of tag gids to attach to the subtask.

start_on.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-01"

completed.description: Whether the subtask is marked completed.

liked.description: Whether the subtask is liked by the authorized user.

actions.description: Create a tag in a workspace.
actions.name: create-tag

workspace_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the workspace or organization. Example: "12345"

name.description: Name of the tag. Example: "Stuff to buy"

project_gid.description: Globally unique identifier for the project. Example: "120987654321"

notes.description: Free-form text notes for the project.

due_on.description: Date (ISO 8601) on which the project is due. Example: "2026-12-31".

start_on.description: Date (ISO 8601) on which the project starts. Example: "2026-01-01".

public.description: Whether the project is public to its workspace members.

is_template.description: Whether the project is a template.

actions.name: update-section

actions.description: Update mutable fields on a task.
actions.name: update-task

task_gid.description: The globally unique identifier of the task to update. Example: "123456789"

name.description: The new name of the task.

notes.description: Free-form textual information associated with the task (its description).

assignee.description: The user gid to assign the task to, or null to remove the assignee.

completed.description: Whether the task is marked complete.

due_at.description: The UTC due date and time as an ISO 8601 string, or null to clear.

due_on.description: The localized due date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null to clear.

start_on.description: The start date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null to clear.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field gid, or null to clear all.

parent.description: The parent task gid to make this a subtask, or null to remove parent.

liked.description: Whether the task is liked by the authenticated user.

resource_subtype.description: The subtype of the task, e.g. "default_task".

approval_status.description: The approval status of the task, e.g. "pending", "approved", "rejected".
